seoTitle: Transfer a Domain From GoDaddy to Squarespace
metaDescription: Move your domain from GoDaddy to Squarespace by connecting or transferring it, so your website and domain settings live in one place.
intro: Centralizing your domain and website under Squarespace simplifies management and removes the need for a separate registrar dashboard. This guide covers connecting a GoDaddy domain to your Squarespace site, from the GoDaddy side through to confirming the connection in Squarespace.

steps.heading: Log in to Squarespace
steps.body: Sign in to your account, or create one if you're new, so you have a site ready to connect the domain to.

steps.heading: Start the transfer in GoDaddy
steps.body: In GoDaddy, click Domains, select Transfer Domains, and enter the domain you want to move over.

steps.heading: Connect the domain to your site
steps.body: In My Products, find the domain, click Manage, and use the connect option to forward domain traffic to your Squarespace site.

steps.heading: Finish the connection in Squarespace
steps.body: In Squarespace, go to Settings, then Domains, choose Connect Third Party Domain, enter your domain, select GoDaddy, and click Connect.

steps.heading: Manage domain settings in Squarespace
steps.body: Under Settings, Domains, you can register and manage domains with Squarespace or continue managing third-party domains like this one.

faq.question: Do I need to fully transfer the domain, or can I just connect it?
faq.answer: Squarespace supports connecting a third-party domain from GoDaddy without a full registrar transfer, which is the quicker route shown in this guide.

faq.question: Why would I move a domain from GoDaddy to Squarespace?
faq.answer: Registering and managing your domain through Squarespace centralizes your website and domain settings instead of juggling two providers.

faq.question: What if I run into an issue during the transfer?
faq.answer: Contact GoDaddy Support by phone, text, or chat for help resolving technical problems on their end.

faq.question: Do I need to already own a domain to use this process?
faq.answer: Yes, this guide covers connecting a domain you already registered with GoDaddy — you can search for a new domain separately if needed.
